beartooth-red-lodge-to-cooke-city.title: Beartooth · Red Lodge to Cooke City
beartooth-red-lodge-to-cooke-city.slogan: A 156 km loop out of Beartooth Pass
beartooth-red-lodge-to-cooke-city.story: Alpine lakes, high altitude and an official status check before coffee. The stops in between: Top of the World store, Cooke City and Yellowstone northeast. Beartooth Pass is the high point. It tops out at about 2,850 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-stadhuis-en-belforttoren-mill-net.story: A 267 km round trip from Lier - roughly 4 h 36 in the saddle.
